source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
With GENESTEALER CULTS as your Army Faction, your Resurgence point pool at the start of the battle depends on battle size: 6 for Incursion, 10 for Strike Force, 14 for Onslaught. Whenever a unit of yours is destroyed and all of its non-CHARACTER models have this ability, you may pay Resurgence points based on its Starting Strength, not counting attached CHARACTER models: Aberrants 4 for 5 models or 8 for 10; Acolyte Hybrids with Autopistols, Acolyte Hybrids with Hand Flamers and Hybrid Metamorphs 2 for 5 or 4 for 10; Atalan Jackals 2 for 5 or 6 for 10; Neophyte Hybrids 3 for 10 or 6 for 20; Purestrain Genestealers 2 for 5 or 6 for 10. Paying adds to your army a fresh copy of the destroyed unit, minus any CHARACTER models, which goes into Cult Ambush at full Starting Strength with no wounds lost and with its [ONE SHOT] weapons treated as unfired. You also put down one Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield over 9" from every enemy unit, measured horizontally; where no such spot exists, no marker is placed.
Cult Ambush counts as a form of Strategic Reserves; the Rapid Ingress Stratagem cannot target units in it. Such units may enter by way of the markers described below, or under the usual Strategic Reserves rules in a later turn, and they are not automatically destroyed when the third battle round ends.
Each Cult Ambush marker is a 32mm circle. Whenever an enemy model that is not an AIRCRAFT finishes a move of any kind within 8" of one of your markers, that marker is removed. When the next Movement phase of your opponent ends, for every marker of yours still in play you may choose one of your units in Cult Ambush and have it make an ingress move: place it with one or more models touching that marker and all its other models wholly within 3" of the marker, then take the marker away. Units in Cult Ambush may arrive this way even during the first battle round.
